title: 한자어 숫자: 전화번호와 가격 말하기
objective: By the end, you can read a Korean phone number aloud digit by digit and say simple prices such as 천 원 or 만 이천 원.
summary: Learn the Sino-Korean numbers used to say phone numbers, floors, minutes and prices in won.

task.title: Read and say numbers
task.line: Use only the number words on this sheet to write, choose or say each number in Korean.

words.meaning: zero (said when reading phone numbers digit by digit)
one (used with units such as floors, minutes and won)
words.exampleMeaning: The restroom is on the first floor.

words.meaning: two (here in the month name 이월, February)
words.exampleMeaning: I came to Korea in February.

words.meaning: won, the Korean currency (comes after the number)

words.exampleMeaning: Could you tell me your phone number?

exercises: Write how you say each number in Korean: ① 13 ② 20 ③ 3,000 ④ 12,000
Choose how Koreans say it: ① 1,000원 (일천 원 / 천 원) ② 10원 (일십 원 / 십 원) ③ 10,000원 (일만 원 / 만 원)
Read this phone number aloud and write it in Korean: 010-3122-1302
Fill in the blank: A: ____가 뭐예요? B: 공일공 이이삼일 일일이공이에요.
You give the cashier one 10,000-won bill. Fill in the blank: 여기 ____ 원이요.
Answer in Korean with the price: 바나나 우유 3,020원 — A: 이거 얼마예요? B: ____.
answers: ① 십삼 ② 이십 ③ 삼천 ④ 만 이천 (만이천)
① 천 원 ② 십 원 ③ 만 원
